run_convert_audio_to_16k: run the script to convert all audio files in a directory to 16kHz WAV format using sox
run_find_all_files: run find_all_files to recursively list all files with a given extension in a directory
run_convert16k_single: run convert16k to convert a single audio file to 16kHz mono WAV using sox
refactor_find_all_files: refactor find_all_files to return relative paths instead of absolute paths
review_convert16k: review convert16k to add error handling for sox subprocess failures
